notes: Actual results for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025, as the county reported them in its F-65 Annual Local Unit Fiscal Report to the Michigan Department of Treasury. Not a budget.
Public schools are run by separate school districts with their own taxes, so they are not included.

Spending is reported by function for the general fund, other governmental funds, enterprise funds (water, sewer and other utilities) and component units (such as downtown development authorities). Capital outlay has no function, so enterprise capital counts as utilities and the rest is spread over the other spending in proportion.
Component units are included: the county road commission and other authorities the county appoints and funds.
Internal service funds ($2,213,149 of their revenue and spending) are left out, since the departments they serve report that spending.
Borrowing, transfers between funds, sales of capital assets, depreciation and extraordinary items are left out.
General government, courts, community and economic development, and redevelopment and public housing count as overhead.
Debt is total long-term debt at year end, as reported on the F-65.
Political money is not scored: Michigan county candidates file campaign finance reports with their county clerk, not with the state.
Transparency practices have not been checked yet, so they are not scored.

Red flags: surveillance programs come from the EFF Atlas of Surveillance, a public database of news reports and public records, searched on 2026-10-18. A town or county with none listed may still have programs nobody has reported. Data center deals, corporate tax breaks and license-plate cameras mapped by volunteers have not been checked for Michigan yet. Most records carry no dollar amount, so each documented program costs a quarter of the red-flag points instead of being counted as spending.

redFlags.label: Face recognition
redFlags.detail: The Crawford County Sheriff's Office has desktop access to Michigan State Police's face recognition system, the Statewide Network of Agency Photos (SNAP).
